headword: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}
reading: せいりょういんりょう

definitions.explanation: a non-alcoholic beverage, especially one that is commercially packaged and sold, such as soda, juice, or tea

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}の{売上|うりあげ}が{伸|の}びている。
{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}で{清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a soft drink from a vending machine.

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}の{飲|の}みすぎは{糖分|とうぶん}の{取|と}りすぎにつながるので{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Drinking too many soft drinks can lead to excessive sugar intake, so caution is needed.

notes:
A formal/commercial term for non-alcoholic packaged beverages. Composed of {清涼|せいりょう} (cool, refreshing) + {飲料|いんりょう} (beverage). Under Japanese food labeling law, {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい} is the official category that includes carbonated drinks, juices, teas, sports drinks, and similar products. In everyday conversation, people more commonly say ジュース or {飲|の}み{物|もの}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい} — soft drink (official regulatory term with {水|すい})
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}メーカー — soft drink manufacturer
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}{市場|しじょう} — soft drink market
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}の{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき} — soft drink vending machine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ジュース — juice (in Japanese, broadly used for any sweet drink, not just fruit juice)
- ソフトドリンク — soft drink (loanword, common in restaurants)
- {飲|の}み{物|もの} — drink, beverage (most general everyday term)
- {飲料|いんりょう} — beverage (slightly formal; includes alcoholic drinks too)
